name: Hook of the Depths

pages.text: Install on a rod at the Angling Table to fish in the void.

pages.title: Fitting and use
pages.text: Craft the hook with Crying Obsidian and Dragon’s Breath through JEI. Install it on a supported rod. Cast into a void surface that current Tide rules consider fishable; the hook does not create a fishing pool or bypass individual fish requirements.

jem_summary: Install on a rod at the Angling Table to fish in the void.
